title: Definitions of Spiritual Maladies
english: 3. Ecstasy is a turning back toward the evil of the rational soul after virtue and the knowledge of God.
4. Distress is a state of the ruling rational soul, by which it is filled with virtues not for the sake of the beautiful itself.
5. Nose-snorting is a deprivation of the perceived virtue of the fragrance of Christ.
6. Cutting is a hardness of the rational soul toward the drawing-in spiritual teaching.
7. Ephelis is a falling away from spiritual contemplation, or a non-truthful understanding of events.
8. Logorrhea is a passion of the rational part of the soul, by which, being disturbed by things happening, it is unable to give thanks to God in all things (1 Thess 5:18).
9. Lameness is an incapacity of the rational soul toward the work of virtue.
10. Sweating is a turning away of the irrational soul, by which the virtues are extinguished.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Metaphorical Definitions
english: Evil and ignorance prevail. 17. An ant is a practical man preparing his own food in this age. 18. Swine are unclean nations having received the commandments of our Savior Christ. 19. kingless locusts are rational souls unshaken by death and nourished on seeds. 20. A gecko is a practical mind supported by virtues and dwelling in the knowledge of the heavenly powers. 21. A lion's roar is a man impassive toward the beasts occurring within him, having ruled. 22. A rooster is a spiritual man being filled with knowledge and evangelizing to souls the day coming from the intelligible sun. 23. A goat is a practical man being rightly guided in the unruly thoughts within him. 24. A leech is an unclean nature, the righteous blood from the rational souls.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Definitions of Symbols
english: Hades is the ignorance of rational soul occurring through the deprivation of the vision of God. Woman is folly, calling rational souls toward impurity. Earth is a state of gathering what is controlled by impiety and lawlessness. Fire is the wickedness of rational soul, corrupting the virtues of God. Water is false knowledge extinguishing the knowledge of truth. A mocking eye is an impure nature mocking the knowledge of God and dishonoring the wisdom found in things that exist. Crows are holy powers, corrupting evils. Canyons are rational souls hollowed out by wickedness and ignorance. Young eagles are holy powers having believed in casting down the impure.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
